permission: New human approval must enumerate exact targets/channels/day/window/PAPER/budgets and prohibit accounts/orders; CLI flag or old approvals never suffice
preflight: Current security/market, exchange session, PAPER service and four-slot entitlement, subscription hours/terms/fees, endpoint and transport protection require hashed evidence; unknown blocks before auth
transport: Official ws endpoint is unencrypted; no speculative wss/host fallback; protected transport evidence required, never a boolean risk waiver
time_policy: Record UTC receive immediately, monotonic ns, post-parse validated availability, and finalized/quote times separately; unverified local clock prohibits network-latency claims
storage: Git-excluded data/data-first-private-df014-pilot; immutable raw/receipt lineage, segmented FrameArchive, total-file peak guard and persistent budgets
failure_policy: Failed attempts charged before I/O; process lock; no token persistence/re-auth after restart; reconnect taints window; bounded queue overflow/unknown integrity/storage/window end stops; no reschedule
observed_metrics: NULL until actual authorized collection; synthetic throughput reported separately
